description: Update a secret group's description or field values; its secretType and groupName are fixed. In `fields`, a non-empty value sets the field (adding a missing optional one), an empty string clears an optional field (a required field cannot be cleared), and an omitted field stays unchanged. Call muggle-remote-secret-type-list for each secretType's fields, which are required, and their formats. Secret values are never returned.

fields.description: Field name → new value. A non-empty value sets the field (adding a missing optional one); an empty string clears an optional field; omitted fields stay unchanged

name: muggle-remote-secret-group-update
